1.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump’s White House Ballroom Construction
1.summary: Lower-court rulings would have blocked construction of the 90,000-square-foot ballroom after finding that the Trump administration should have first sought approval from Congress.

2.title: Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
2.summary: But Chief Justice John Roberts dissents, writing that "construction is likely unlawful".

3.title: Teen Charged With Murder After Livestreaming San Diego Mosque Shooting
3.summary: The authorities said the 17-year-old from North Carolina had recorded the attack, which killed three people in May. “She ran with the pack — she shared in the kill,” the district attorney said.

4.title: Lionel Messi’s Retirement From Soccer Sparks Heartbreak Across Argentina
4.summary: Lionel Messi’s retirement from the national soccer team, though widely expected, sparked fears of a diminished squad, and heartbreak over the departure of a national icon.
